final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT r.ordervault AS ov, u.acctscope AS scope, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ordervault) AS c FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault JOIN users u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink GROUP BY r.ordervault, u.acctscope), s2 AS (SELECT scope, SUM(c) AS sc FROM s1 GROUP BY scope), s3 AS (SELECT SUM(sc) AS tot FROM s2), s4 AS (SELECT s2.scope AS scope, s2.sc AS sc, CAST(s2.sc AS REAL) / NULLIF(s3.tot, 0) AS share FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.tot IS NOT NULL), s5 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS av FROM s4) SELECT s4.scope, s4.sc, s4.share, s4.share / NULLIF(s5.av, 0) AS ratio FROM s4 JOIN s5 ON s5.av IS NOT NULL
